order.role: Direction, decisions, roadmap and the SA-n debt register — canonical for everything else in this repo (two apps share one direction, so it lives in the kit).
Why the product exists — white-label first, aggregator as a server project.

repoSpecificNotes: Generated types stop at the controller boundary — SalonKit maps wire to app models; payload() is the call shape; views never see Components.Schemas.*.
The salon is configuration: Salon.xcconfig (committed mock defaults) -> optional gitignored Salon.local.xcconfig -> SalonBook-Info.plist -> SalonConfiguration; user tokens belong in the Keychain.
The pbxproj is generated by XcodeGen from project.yml and gitignored — run xcodegen generate after clone; Package.resolved stays tracked.
The API's quirks (envelope dialects, spec patches P1–P27) are documented in the Salon1c package's catalog, not here.
SalonKit is a .static library product — an OSLogLoggingMiddleware upstream-manifest workaround, see SA-8.
No live credentials yet (SA-2) — every verified behaviour is against the vendor's Apiary mock.
